AN ACT to amend the highway law, in relation to state liability for defects in
highways
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S671

SPONSOR: BOYLE
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the highway law, in relation to state liability for
defects in highways

 
PURPOSE:

This bill expands the state's liability for damages suffered by individ-
uals due to defects in state highways when the state has actual or
constructive notice of such defects.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 of the bill amends section 58 of the state highway law to
provide that the state shall be liable for damages suffered by any
person for defects in state highways maintained by the state under such
system as the commissioner of transportation may adopt pursuant to
section twelve to of this chapter, providing the state has received
actual or constructive notice of such defects.

Section 2 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Under current law, individuals who suffer damages due to defects in
state highways may pursue these damages only if the incident occurred
within the first day of May to November 15. Recent reports of three-foot
wide potholes and other seemingly ongoing defects in state highways
highlight the need to modify this statute and provide for more flexibil-
ity to better protect New York State motorists.

This bill allows for individuals to pursue damages from the state for
defects in state roads all year so long as the state has received actual
or constructive notice of such defects. This bill will protect the state
from lawsuits for defects it does not have notice of, while ensuring New
York State taxpayers do not have to pay out-of-pocket for damages caused
by a defect in a state highway that should have been repaired.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2015/16: A425 referred to judiciary;
2014: A9883-A referred to judiciary
2017/18: Referred to Transportation

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately and shall apply to any cause of
action that accrues on or after such effective date.

summary: Relates to the liability of the state to any person who suffers damage as a result of a defect in a state highway.
title: Relates to state liability for potholes on state highways
